passages.text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
passages.sermon:
A gentle answer turns away wrath.
A gentle answer calms anger.
A harsh word stirs up anger.
A harsh word makes people angry.
passages.original: מַֽעֲנֶה־ רַּ֭ךְ יָשִׁ֣יב חֵמָ֑ה וּדְבַר־ עֶ֝֗צֶב יַעֲלֶה־ אָֽף׃

passages.text: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of the fool spouts folly.
passages.sermon:
Wise people speak with understanding.
Their words show knowledge.
Foolish people speak without wisdom.
Their words show foolishness.
passages.original: לְשׁ֣וֹן חֲ֭כָמִים תֵּיטִ֣יב דָּ֑עַת וּפִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

passages.text: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, observing the evil and the good.
passages.sermon:
The LORD sees everything.
His eyes are everywhere.
He watches all people.
He sees those who do evil.
He sees those who do good.
passages.original: בְּֽכָל־ מָ֭קוֹם עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה צֹ֝פ֗וֹת רָעִ֥ים וטוֹבִֽים׃

passages.text: A soothing tongue is a tree of life, but a perverse tongue crushes the spirit.
passages.sermon:
A soothing tongue brings healing.
A soothing tongue is like a tree of life.
A perverse tongue causes harm.
A perverse tongue crushes the spirit.
passages.original: מַרְפֵּ֣א לָ֭שׁוֹן עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְסֶ֥לֶף בָּ֝֗הּ שֶׁ֣בֶר בְּרֽוּחַ׃

passages.text: A fool rejects his father’s discipline, but whoever heeds correction is prudent.
passages.sermon:
A fool rejects his father’s discipline.
A fool does not accept correction from his father.
A prudent person listens to correction.
A prudent person accepts instruction.
Whoever heeds correction becomes wise.
passages.original: אֱוִ֗יל יִ֭נְאַץ מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יַעְרִֽם׃

passages.text: The house of the righteous has great treasure, but the income of the wicked is trouble.
passages.sermon:
A righteous person lives in a house.
This house has great treasure.
A wicked person earns income.
This income brings trouble.
passages.original: בֵּ֣ית צַ֭דִּיק חֹ֣סֶן רָ֑ב וּבִתְבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע נֶעְכָּֽרֶת׃

passages.text: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but not so the hearts of fools.
passages.sermon:
Wise people speak with their lips.
They spread knowledge.
Foolish people do not do this.
The hearts of fools do not spread knowledge.
passages.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲ֭כָמִים יְזָ֣רוּ דָ֑עַת וְלֵ֖ב כְּסִילִ֣ים לֹא־ כֵֽן׃

passages.text: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is His delight.
passages.sermon:
The LORD hates the sacrifice of wicked people.
The LORD finds the sacrifice of wicked people detestable.
The LORD loves the prayer of upright people.
The LORD delights in the prayer of upright people.
passages.original: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּתְפִלַּ֖ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The LORD detests the way of the wicked, but He loves those who pursue righteousness.
passages.sermon: The LORD hates the way of the wicked.\r\nThe LORD loves people who pursue righteousness.
passages.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ רָשָׁ֑ע וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף צְדָקָ֣ה יֶאֱהָֽב׃

passages.text: Discipline is harsh for him who leaves the path; he who hates correction will die.
passages.sermon: A person who leaves the right path receives harsh discipline.\r\nA person who hates correction will die.
passages.original: מוּסָ֣ר רָ֭ע לְעֹזֵ֣ב אֹ֑רַח שׂוֹנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת יָמֽוּת׃

passages.text: Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the LORD— how much more the hearts of men!
passages.sermon:
The LORD sees everything.
Sheol is the place of the dead.
Abaddon is the place of destruction.
Sheol and Abaddon are open before the LORD.
Nothing in Sheol or Abaddon is hidden from Him.
The LORD also sees the hearts of all people.
He knows every thought and feeling in every heart.
If Sheol and Abaddon are open to Him, the hearts of men are even more so.
passages.original: שְׁא֣וֹל וַ֭אֲבַדּוֹן נֶ֣גֶד יְהוָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־ לִבּ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־ אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: A mocker does not love to be reproved, nor will he consult the wise.
passages.sermon:
A mocker does not love correction.
A mocker rejects reproof.
A mocker does not seek advice from wise people.
A mocker avoids the company of the wise.
passages.original: לֹ֣א יֶאֱהַב־ לֵ֭ץ הוֹכֵ֣חַֽ ל֑וֹ אֶל־ חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א יֵלֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: A joyful heart makes a cheerful countenance, but sorrow of the heart crushes the spirit.
passages.sermon: A joyful heart brings a cheerful face.\r\nSorrow in the heart breaks the spirit.
passages.original: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב פָּנִ֑ים וּבְעַצְּבַת־ לֵ֝ב ר֣וּחַ נְכֵאָֽה׃

passages.text: A discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly.
passages.sermon:
A discerning person has a wise heart.
A wise heart seeks knowledge.
A foolish person does not seek knowledge.
A fool feeds on foolishness.
A fool prefers folly over wisdom.
passages.original: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ־ דָּ֑עַת וּפְנֵי כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יִרְעֶ֥ה אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

passages.text: All the days of the oppressed are bad, but a cheerful heart has a continual feast.
passages.sermon:
The oppressed person suffers every day.
Every day is bad for the oppressed person.
A cheerful heart brings joy.
A cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
passages.original: כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י עָנִ֣י רָעִ֑ים וְטֽוֹב־ לֵ֝֗ב מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃

passages.text: Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure with turmoil.
passages.sermon:
A person who fears the LORD is wise.
It is better to have only a little if you fear the LORD.
It is not good to have great treasure with turmoil.
Great treasure with trouble is worse than a little with the fear of the LORD.
passages.original: טוֹב־ מְ֭עַט בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מֵאוֹצָ֥ר רָ֝֗ב וּמְה֥וּמָה בֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Better a dish of vegetables where there is love than a fattened ox with hatred.
passages.sermon:
Love in a home is very important.
A simple meal with love is good.
A plate of vegetables with love is better than a rich meal with hatred.
A fattened ox with hatred is not good.
Love makes even a small meal better than a feast with hate.
passages.original: ט֤וֹב אֲרֻחַ֣ת יָ֭רָק וְאַהֲבָה־ שָׁ֑ם מִשּׁ֥וֹר אָ֝ב֗וּס וְשִׂנְאָה־ בֽוֹ׃

passages.text: A hot-tempered man stirs up strife, but he who is slow to anger calms dispute.
passages.sermon:
A hot-tempered man stirs up strife.
He acts with anger.
He causes conflict.
A patient man is slow to anger.
He calms disputes.
He brings peace.
passages.original: אִ֣ישׁ חֵ֭מָה יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וְאֶ֥רֶך אַ֝פַּ֗יִם יַשְׁקִ֥יט רִֽיב׃

passages.text: The way of the slacker is like a hedge of thorns, but the path of the upright is a highway.
passages.sermon:
A slacker is a lazy person.
The way of a slacker is hard to walk.
It is like a hedge of thorns.
The upright person does what is right.
The path of the upright is smooth and clear.
It is like a highway.
passages.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ עָ֭צֵל כִּמְשֻׂ֣כַת חָ֑דֶק וְאֹ֖רַח יְשָׁרִ֣ים סְלֻלָֽה׃

passages.text: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.
passages.sermon: A wise son brings joy to his father.\r\nA foolish man despises his mother.
passages.original: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח־ אָ֑ב וּכְסִ֥יל אָ֝דָ֗ם בּוֹזֶ֥ה אִמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Folly is joy to one who lacks judgment, but a man of understanding walks a straight path.
passages.sermon: A person who lacks judgment finds joy in foolishness.\r\nA man of understanding walks a straight path.
passages.original: אִ֭וֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַחֲסַר־ לֵ֑ב וְאִ֥ישׁ תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה יְיַשֶׁר־ לָֽכֶת׃

passages.text: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.
passages.sermon: Plans need good advice to succeed.\r\nIf people do not seek counsel, their plans will fail.\r\nMany advisers help plans to stand and succeed.
passages.original: הָפֵ֣ר מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּאֵ֣ין ס֑וֹד וּבְרֹ֖ב יוֹעֲצִ֣ים תָּקֽוּם׃

passages.text: A man takes joy in a fitting reply— and how good is a timely word!
passages.sermon: A man feels joy when he gives a fitting reply.\r\nA timely word is good.
passages.original: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לָ֭אִישׁ בְּמַעֲנֵה־ פִ֑יו וְדָבָ֖ר בְּעִתּ֣וֹ מַה־ טּֽוֹב׃

passages.text: The path of life leads upward for the wise, that he may avoid going down to Sheol.
passages.sermon:
The wise person chooses the path of life.
This path goes upward.
The wise person avoids going down to Sheol.
Sheol means the place of the dead.
The wise person escapes death by following the upward path.
passages.original: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים לְמַ֣עְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּ֑יל לְמַ֥עַן ס֝֗וּר מִשְּׁא֥וֹל מָֽטָּה׃

passages.text: The LORD tears down the house of the proud, but He protects the boundaries of the widow.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acts with power and justice.
The LORD destroys the house of proud people.
The LORD protects the property of widows.
The LORD keeps the boundaries of widows safe.
passages.original: בֵּ֣ית גֵּ֭אִים יִסַּ֥ח׀ יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝יַצֵּ֗ב גְּב֣וּל אַלְמָנָֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the words of the pure are pleasant to Him.
passages.sermon: The LORD hates the thoughts of wicked people.\r\nThe LORD finds the words of pure people pleasant.
passages.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת רָ֑ע וּ֝טְהֹרִ֗ים אִמְרֵי־ נֹֽעַם׃

passages.text: He who is greedy for unjust gain brings trouble on his household, but he who hates bribes will live.
passages.sermon:
A greedy person seeks unjust gain.
This person brings trouble to his own household.
A person who hates bribes will live.
God opposes greed and injustice.
God gives life to those who reject corruption.
passages.original: עֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וְשׂוֹנֵ֖א מַתָּנֹ֣ת יִחְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked blurts out evil.
passages.sermon:
A righteous person thinks carefully before answering.
A righteous person uses wisdom in speech.
A wicked person speaks without thinking.
A wicked person quickly says evil things.
passages.original: לֵ֣ב צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לַעֲנ֑וֹת וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ רָעֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The LORD is far from the wicked, but He hears the prayer of the righteous.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is far from the wicked.
The LORD does not stay close to people who do evil.
The LORD hears the prayer of the righteous.
The LORD listens to people who do what is right.
passages.original: רָח֣וֹק יְ֭הוָה מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים וּתְפִלַּ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע׃

passages.text: The light of the eyes cheers the heart, and good news nourishes the bones.
passages.sermon: A cheerful look brings joy to the heart.\r\nGood news gives strength to the body.
passages.original: מְֽאוֹר־ עֵ֭ינַיִם יְשַׂמַּֽח־ לֵ֑ב שְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה תְּדַשֶּׁן־ עָֽצֶם׃

passages.text: He who listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise.
passages.sermon: A wise person listens to correction that gives life.\r\nThis person lives among other wise people.
passages.original: אֹ֗זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת תּוֹכַ֣חַת חַיִּ֑ים בְּקֶ֖רֶב חֲכָמִ֣ים תָּלִֽין׃

passages.text: He who ignores discipline despises himself, but whoever heeds correction gains understanding.
passages.sermon:
A person who ignores discipline harms himself.
He shows that he despises his own life.
A person who listens to correction gains understanding.
He becomes wise in heart.
passages.original: פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מ֭וּסָר מוֹאֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְשׁוֹמֵ֥עַ תּ֝וֹכַ֗חַת ק֣וֹנֶה לֵּֽב׃

passages.text: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom, and humility comes before honor.
passages.sermon: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom.\r\nHumility comes before honor.
passages.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מוּסַ֣ר חָכְמָ֑ה וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה׃
